#!/bin/bash

echo "Finding symbolic links in /tmp/mcp-workspace..."
find /tmp/mcp-workspace -type l > /tmp/mcp-workspace/all_symlinks.txt

echo "Checking which links are broken..."
> /tmp/mcp-workspace/broken_links.txt

while read -r link; do
    if [ ! -e "$link" ]; then
        echo "$link" >> /tmp/mcp-workspace/broken_links.txt
    fi
done < /tmp/mcp-workspace/all_symlinks.txt

count=$(wc -l < /tmp/mcp-workspace/broken_links.txt)
echo "Found $count broken symbolic links."
echo "List saved to /tmp/mcp-workspace/broken_links.txt"

# Display the broken links
if [ $count -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "Broken symbolic links:"
    cat /tmp/mcp-workspace/broken_links.txt
else
    echo "No broken symbolic links found."
fi
